ROWS.title: Constitution and SSM records: Borrower
ROWS.req: Certified constitution, certificate of incorporation and SSM company profile of the Borrower.

ROWS.title: Constitution and ACRA profile: Holdco
ROWS.req: Certified constitution, certificate of incorporation and ACRA business profile of Holdco.

ROWS.title: Constitution and ACRA profile: Sponsor
ROWS.req: Certified constitution and ACRA business profile of Halcyon Digital Infrastructure Pte. Ltd.
ROWS.note: Received 22 Oct 2026 from Mercer Quay LLC.

ROWS.title: Fund documents: Co-sponsor
ROWS.req: Certificate of registration, LPA (certified), GP certificate of good standing, register of mortgages and charges.
ROWS.note: C. Bodden, 23 Oct 2026: certificate of good standing dated 14 Aug 2026. A new certificate (not older than 30 days at Signing) is required.

ROWS.title: Board resolutions: Borrower
ROWS.req: Board resolutions approving the Finance Documents and Transaction Security, and naming authorised signatories.
ROWS.note: Draft received 22 Oct 2026; signed copy to follow.

ROWS.title: Board and shareholder resolutions: Holdco
ROWS.req: Board resolutions and shareholder resolution approving the share charge over the Borrower and the guarantee.

ROWS.title: Board resolutions: Sponsor
ROWS.req: Board resolutions approving the Sponsor Support and Equity Contribution Agreement and the Singapore share charge.

ROWS.title: GP resolutions: Co-sponsor
ROWS.req: Resolutions of the general partner approving the equity commitment and the capital call security; LPAC consent if the LPA requires it.

ROWS.title: Specimen signatures
ROWS.req: Specimen signature of each authorised signatory of each Obligor.

ROWS.title: Officer's certificate (each Obligor)
ROWS.req: Certificate: borrowing and guarantee limits not exceeded, documents are true copies and in force, no Default. Dated on or near the Utilisation Date.

ROWS.title: Company and winding-up searches
ROWS.req: SSM company search and winding-up search on the Borrower; ACRA and Cayman searches on the other Obligors (updated within 2 Business Days of Utilisation).
ROWS.note: Initial searches clear. Update searches due 25 Nov 2026.

ROWS.title: Senior Facilities Agreement
ROWS.req: LMA-based (APLMA form) facilities agreement signed by all parties. Agreed form v.9.
ROWS.note: Signed pages held in escrow by Ashcombe & Reid (Borrower, MLAs). Agent page outstanding.

ROWS.title: Intercreditor Agreement
ROWS.req: Senior lenders, hedge counterparties, Sponsor and Co-sponsor (subordinated creditors), Security Agents.
ROWS.note: Co-sponsor comments on turnover clause pending.

ROWS.title: Fee letters
ROWS.req: Arrangement, agency and security agency fee letters.

ROWS.title: Hedging documents
ROWS.req: ISDA 2002 master agreements, schedules and hedging letter with each Hedge Counterparty.

ROWS.title: Sponsor Support and Equity Contribution Agreement
ROWS.req: Equity commitment of US$343m, cost overrun support and completion undertakings.

ROWS.title: Subordination Deed
ROWS.req: Subordination of shareholder loans from Holdco to the Borrower.

ROWS.title: Malaysian Security Trust Deed
ROWS.req: Appointment of the Onshore Security Agent as security trustee for the Finance Parties.

ROWS.title: Account Bank Agreement
ROWS.req: Onshore project accounts, waterfall and signing mandates.

ROWS.title: Utilisation Request
ROWS.req: Signed Utilisation Request for the first Utilisation, delivered 3 Business Days before the Utilisation Date.

ROWS.title: Malaysian Debenture
ROWS.req: Fixed and floating charges over all present and future assets of the Borrower.

ROWS.title: Assignment of contract proceeds
ROWS.req: Assignment of EPC contract, tenant lease, grid connection agreement and O&M contract, with notices.

ROWS.title: Charge over Borrower shares
ROWS.req: Share charge by Holdco, original share certificates, undated share transfer forms and blank-dated director resignation letters.

ROWS.title: Singapore share charge over Holdco shares
ROWS.req: Share charge by Sponsor, share certificates, undated instruments of transfer, letter of undertaking and authorisation.

ROWS.title: Assignment of insurances
ROWS.req: Assignment of construction and operational insurances; loss payee clause in favour of the Onshore Security Agent.

ROWS.title: Account charge and notice
ROWS.req: Charge over onshore project accounts, with notice to and acknowledgement from the Account Bank.

ROWS.title: Charge over leasehold land
ROWS.req: Charge over the data centre site under the National Land Code. Needs State Authority consent to charge.
ROWS.note: N. Rahman, 22 Oct 2026: consent not yet granted. Proposal: Majority Lenders agree to move this item to conditions subsequent (see CS-4).

ROWS.title: Assignment of subordinated loans
ROWS.req: Assignment by Sponsor of its rights under shareholder loans to Holdco.

ROWS.title: Capital call security (Co-sponsor)
ROWS.req: Security over uncalled capital commitments of Fjordline DC Fund L.P., with notices to investors and power of attorney to issue calls.

ROWS.title: EPC direct agreement
ROWS.req: Direct agreement with the EPC contractor (Stratus Build Asia Sdn. Bhd.) with step-in rights.

ROWS.title: Tenant direct agreement and lease consent
ROWS.req: Direct agreement and consent to assignment from the anchor hyperscale tenant (Tenant A).
ROWS.note: Tenant A asks to limit lender step-in to 60 days. Commercial decision for the MLAs.

ROWS.title: Grid connection consent
ROWS.req: Consent of the grid operator to the assignment of the connection agreement.

ROWS.title: Payoff letter: Kestrel Bank
ROWS.req: Payoff letter stating the outstanding amount, daily interest, break costs and payment account; undertaking to release security on receipt.

ROWS.title: Deeds of release (existing security)
ROWS.req: Releases of the existing Malaysian debenture and Singapore share charge in agreed form, signed and held in escrow until payoff.

ROWS.title: Return of share certificates
ROWS.req: Kestrel Bank returns original Holdco share certificates and transfer forms to the Offshore Security Agent at payoff.

ROWS.title: Funds flow memorandum
ROWS.req: Agreed funds flow for the first Utilisation: payoff, fees, costs, equity and project accounts.

ROWS.title: English law opinion
ROWS.req: Enforceability opinion on the English law Finance Documents.

ROWS.title: Malaysian law opinion
ROWS.req: Capacity, authority and enforceability of Malaysian Finance Documents and Transaction Security.

ROWS.title: Singapore law opinion
ROWS.req: Capacity of Holdco and Sponsor; enforceability of the Singapore share charge and assignment.
ROWS.by: Beyond Horizons by Bethel Chambers LLC

ROWS.title: Cayman law opinion
ROWS.req: Capacity and authority of the Co-sponsor and its general partner; capital call security.

ROWS.title: Process agent appointment
ROWS.req: Acceptance of appointment by the process agent for each non-English Obligor.

ROWS.title: Base case model and model audit
ROWS.req: Agreed base case financial model and Model Auditor's report (minimum DSCR 1.30x).

ROWS.title: Lenders' Technical Adviser report
ROWS.req: Final report: construction programme, power supply, cooling design, PUE and budget.

ROWS.title: Insurance report and certificates
ROWS.req: Insurance Adviser report and certificates of insurance with lender endorsements.

ROWS.title: E&S due diligence and ESAP
ROWS.req: Environmental and social report (Equator Principles) and agreed action plan.

ROWS.title: Evidence of equity contribution
ROWS.req: Evidence that equity of at least 30% of project costs is paid in or secured by acceptable credit support.

ROWS.title: Exchange control confirmation
ROWS.req: Confirmation that the foreign currency borrowing complies with Bank Negara Malaysia foreign exchange policy (demo assumption).

ROWS.title: Key project permits
ROWS.req: Development order, building plan approval and power supply approval for Phase 1 (demo list).

ROWS.title: KYC
ROWS.req: Each Lender's KYC on each Obligor, Sponsor, Co-sponsor and ultimate beneficial owners.

ROWS.title: Original financial statements
ROWS.req: Latest audited financial statements of each Obligor and the Sponsor.

ROWS.title: Fees and costs
ROWS.req: Evidence that fees, costs and expenses due at first Utilisation are paid, or are paid from the first Utilisation under the funds flow.
ROWS.note: Agent, 23 Oct 2026: paid from first Utilisation proceeds under CP-5.4.

ROWS.title: Hedging in place
ROWS.req: Evidence that interest rate hedging covers at least 75% of the term loan for the agreed tenor.

ROWS.title: Register Malaysian security with SSM
ROWS.req: Lodge the Debenture, share charge and assignments with SSM (demo: 30 days after creation).

ROWS.title: Register Singapore share charge with ACRA
ROWS.req: Register the share charge and assignment granted by the Singapore companies (demo: 30 days after creation).

ROWS.title: Stamping of Malaysian documents
ROWS.req: Stamp the Malaysian Finance Documents and Transaction Security (demo: 30 days after execution).

ROWS.title: Land charge registration
ROWS.req: Obtain State Authority consent and present the land charge for registration at the land office.

ROWS.title: File releases of existing security
ROWS.req: File satisfaction of the Kestrel Bank charges at SSM and ACRA.

ROWS.title: Insurance endorsements
ROWS.req: Final policy endorsements naming the Security Agents as loss payee and co-insured.

ROWS.title: Cayman register of mortgages and charges
ROWS.req: Enter the capital call security in the Co-sponsor's register (demo: promptly, within 10 Business Days).
